# cpanel_email_auto_responder (Resource)

Manages one cPanel email autoresponder and its schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_email_auto_responder" "away" {
  email          = "away@example.com"
  from           = "Example Team"
  subject        = "We received your message"
  body           = "We will reply during the next business day."
  charset        = "UTF-8"
  interval_hours = 8
  is_html        = false
  start_unix     = 0
  stop_unix      = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) The autoresponder message body. cPanel's trailing newline is normalized in state.
- `email` (String) The complete responder email address on a mail domain owned by the cPanel account.
- `from` (String) The display name used in autoresponder messages.
- `subject` (String) The autoresponder message subject.

### Optional

- `charset` (String) The message character set. Defaults to `UTF-8`.
- `interval_hours` (Number) Hours to wait before replying again to the same sender. Use `0` to reply to every message.
- `is_html` (Boolean) Whether cPanel should add an HTML content type to the message.
- `start_unix` (Number) Unix timestamp at which the autoresponder becomes active. Use `0` for immediate activation.
- `stop_unix` (Number) Unix timestamp at which the autoresponder becomes inactive. Use `0` for no automatic stop.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_email_auto_responder.away away@example.com
```
